'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***Amid fighting, a [[Food security|food shortage]] is reported in [[Khartoum]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-65335112 (BBC News)]
***An [[American citizen]] is killed in Khartoum, becoming the second confirmed foreign death. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/sudan-american-dead-us-troops-embassy-evacuation-khartoum/ (CBS News)]
**[[Evacuation of foreign nationals during the Sudanese civil war]]
***The [[United States]] sends additional troops and equipment to [[Camp Lemonnier]] in [[Djibouti]] in preparation for a possible [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] of Americans from [[Sudan]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/us-forces-djibouti-prep-sudan-evacuation/story?id=98730208 (ABC News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**Russian authorities report an [[explosion]] in [[Belgorod]] near the border with [[Ukraine]], saying that it left a {{conv|20|m|adj=on}} crater in the city center. It resulted from an accidental discharge of [[ammunition]] from a Russian airplane. [https://www.barrons.com/news/russia-reports-explosion-in-belgorod-near-ukraine-border-59704c32 (''Barron's'' via AFP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/large-blast-reported-russian-city-close-border-with-ukraine-2023-04-20/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Five [[Indian soldier]]s are killed in a suspected militant attack in [[Rajouri district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/21/five-indian-soldiers-killed-in-suspected-rebel-attack-in-kashmir (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**An [[Iranian Navy]] commander claims on state television that the Iranian Navy forced a U.S. submarine to surface as it transited the [[Strait of Hormuz]] and that the submarine violated Iranian territorial waters. The U.S. denies the Iranian claims. [https://www.rferl.org/a/iran-us-submarine-surface-gulf/32372099.html (Radiofarda)]

'''Business and economy'''
*American media site [[BuzzFeed]] reports that it will shut down ''[[BuzzFeed News]]'' as part of its site-wide [[layoff]]s. [https://www.nbcnews.com/business/business-news/buzzfeed-news-shutting-down-rcna80656 (NBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Former [[Peruvian President]] [[Alejandro Toledo]] loses his request for an emergency stay in the [[United States]], as a deadline for his extradition to [[Peru]] nears, where he faces numerous charges. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/lawyers-peruvian-ex-president-toledo-try-block-extradition-us-federal-court-2023-04-20/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Governor of Krasnoyarsk Krai]] [[Aleksandr Uss]] [[Gubernatoropad#Gubernatoropad of Spring 2023|resigns]] after being offered a position in the [[Government of Russia|federal government]]. [[Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] invites Deputy [[Ministry of Finance (Russia)|Finance Minister]] [[Mikhail Kotyukov]] to assume the post of acting governor. [https://tass.ru/politika/17572713 (TASS)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Solar eclipse of April 20, 2023]]
**A [[solar eclipse#Types|hybrid solar eclipse]] occurs across the [[South Pacific]] in [[Australia]], [[East Timor]], and [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/04/20/world/australia/solar-eclipse.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://people.com/human-interest/hybrid-solar-eclipse-2023-everything-to-know/ (''People'')]
*[[SpaceX Starship orbital test flight]]
**[[SpaceX]] launches the first test flight of [[SpaceX Starship|Starship]], the largest and most powerful launch vehicle to ever fly, from [[SpaceX Starbase|Starbase]] in South [[Texas]]. The vehicle successfully launched but lost control and the flight was explosively terminated four minutes after liftoff. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2023/04/20/science/spacex-launch-starship-rocket (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-65334810 (BBC News)]
